start.npc: {npc_name} studies you for a moment, then gives a guarded nod. "Road's been rough on everyone. Say what you came to say."

options.text: I mean no trouble. How are you holding up?
Do you have work for me?
I have strength enough for hard work, if you need it.
Move aside before this gets ugly.

warm_reply.npc: "Better for the asking. Most folk only come close when they want blood or coin."

options.text: Then let us keep this civil.
Maybe one day you'll trust me more than most.

quest_offer.npc: "There is something. {quest_description} Do that, and I will remember it."

stamina_offer.npc: "Good. Then you may be able to handle this: {quest_label}. {quest_description}"

accepted.npc: "Then we understand each other. Come back when {quest_label} is done."

declined.npc: "Then I have nothing more for you."
